open_items: SBS provider_down continuously from cycle 1107 (2026-10-25T10:01Z) through cycle 1117 (2026-10-26T06:01Z): 11 consecutive cycles, ~20 hours, no recovery. Live recheck this run reached the host via the session proxy (CONNECT tunnel established) but the TLS handshake reset after ~13s, consistent with the monitor's own ConnectTimeout findings and confirming provider-side, not session network. A control request to ECB succeeded fine over the same proxy. Escalation checkpoint set at 24h, around cycle 1119 (2026-10-26T10:01Z); not yet reached. Re-check next run; if still down past 24h, treat as a multi-day SBS-side outage worth a human decision.

ILO provider_down at cycle 1114 (2026-10-26T00:01Z, all five checks HTTP 403, Cloudflare edge block) resolved by cycle 1115 (2026-10-26T02:01Z) and confirmed healthy live at cycle 1117. One cycle of downtime. Closed; re-open only if it recurs.
ILO degraded at cycles 1102 and 1108 (single-cycle partial failures): already resolved and reported in earlier entries, superseded by the cycle 1114/1115 incident above.

ESTAT gateway metadata latency flap (climbed toward the 60s deadline through cycles 1102-1113, crossed it once at 1113, recovered at 1114): already reported, working as designed. Watch for a repeat climb.
STATSNZ auth:listing capability_appeared, first seen cycle 60, still present at cycle 1117: listing served without credentials. Still open, not re-reported since no new change.

ILO encoding:structure_xml Content-Type charset/version parameter order flipped again at cycle 1117 (was 'charset=utf-8; version=2.1', now 'version=2.1; charset=utf-8'), verdict stays ok on both sides. Known cosmetic flip, not an incident.
97 claude/ triage branches on origin as of this run's fetch, up from 96 last run. Still above the 20 the skill flags for pruning; not actioned by this read-only routine.

Long-running architectural facts, not incidents: ILO /availableconstraint/ returns 500 (constraints come via ?references=all); ESTAT has no practical constraint support; ESTAT direct json check is skipped by design (Eurostat returns 406 for SDMx-JSON); BIS/ILO/IMF references:contentconstraint reads ignored (accepted and silently dropped); ABS/ILO encoding:structure_xml Content-Type charset/version parameter order flips cosmetically from time to time, verdict always stays ok.
